item.title: Dell r7725 clean installation with Broadcom 57504 Quad Port 10/25GbE
item.author: invalid@example.com (rubikon)
item.dc:creator: rubikon
item.content:encoded:
I had install new VE 9.2 on subj, and after installation i don't have vmbr0 and can't access web interface.

manually i can fix it by console:
ip link add name vmbr0 type bridge
ip link set nic0 master vmbr0
ip addr add *.*.*.123/24 dev vmbr0
ip link set nic0 up
ip link set vmbr0 up
ip route add default via *.*.*.254



and save configuration in /etc/network/interfaces
auto lo
iface lo inet loopback

iface nic0 inet manual

auto vmbr0
iface vmbr0 inet static
address *.*.*.123/24...
